settings.title: System: Runtime Settings
settings.intro: Changes apply to runtime configuration and propagate across processes within five seconds.
settings.saveError: Could not save this setting. Check the value and try again.
settings.revertError: Could not restore the previous value.

labels.era.protectionDurationDays: New-player protection duration in days (1-60; protection also ends at level 10, at the population threshold, or when the player attacks an unprotected player)
labels.ENABLE_MESSAGING: Player messaging (when off, only administrators and moderators can send messages)
labels.recruit.dailyCap: External link recruitment cap (times this player's link may be used per day; also affects the new-player protection population limit)
labels.recruit.internalDailyCap: Internal recruitment cap (recruits a player may claim per day)
labels.recruit.externalIpDailyCap: External link per-IP cap (times one IP may use the same player's link per day)
labels.friend.transferMinLevel: Friend transfer minimum player level (1-100; both sender and receiver)
labels.friend.requestCooldownDays: Days before a declined or ended friendship can be requested again
labels.friend.requestMaxDeclines: Declined requests before a player cannot ask again (0 = no limit)
labels.friend.requestDailyCap: Friend and enemy requests a player can send per day
labels.abuse.funnel.minSharePercent: Funnelling: share of a source’s output (%)
labels.abuse.bot.minHoursPerDay: Bot timing: active hours in a day
labels.abuse.bot.minDays: Bot timing: days at that level
labels.abuse.bot.maxVariationPercent: Bot timing: interval variation at or below (%)
labels.abuse.fresh.accountAgeDays: Fresh accounts: counts while younger than (days)
labels.abuse.fresh.minAttacks: Fresh accounts: attacks by one player needed

settings.resetBeforeLogin: Reset current era before opening logins
settings.staminaHelp: Stamina governs action costs, recovery and the offense penalty below the threshold. Spying costs no stamina.

maintenance.title: System: Maintenance Mode
maintenance.intro: When enabled, non-staff users see the maintenance page. Use this for planned downtime.
maintenance.messageHelp: Shown to visitors while maintenance mode is active. Up to 1000 characters.
